app.name: MeuEcooMedia
app.description: Manage all your TikTok content and social media in one place with MeuEcooMedia.

scopes.name: user.info.basic
scopes.description: Access basic user information (ID, username, profile picture)
scopes.justification: Required to identify which TikTok account content is being published to

scopes.name: user.info.profile
scopes.description: Access the user's profile display name and avatar
scopes.justification: Shown in the dashboard so the user can confirm which connected account they are managing

scopes.name: video.upload
scopes.description: Upload video content to the user's TikTok account
scopes.justification: Allows the user to send a video from the app to their own TikTok account

scopes.name: video.publish
scopes.description: Publish uploaded videos to the user's TikTok profile
scopes.justification: Enables scheduled or manual publishing of content directly to the user's TikTok profile

features.name: Centralized Account Management
features.description: Connect and manage multiple TikTok accounts from one dashboard

features.name: Content Scheduling
features.description: Schedule content publication to TikTok at optimal times

features.name: Automated Token Renewal
features.description: Automatically renew TikTok OAuth tokens to maintain uninterrupted access

features.name: Multi-Platform Management
features.description: Also supports Facebook, Instagram, YouTube alongside TikTok

features.name: Activity Logging
features.description: Track all publication events, errors, and token renewals in real-time
